hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; b=$(basename "$f"); case "$b" in *.example|*.sample) exit 0;; esac; F='{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:$en,permissionDecision:$d,permissionDecisionReason:$r}}'; case "$b" in .env|.env.*) jq -nc --arg en PreToolUse --arg d deny --arg r "Editing env/secret files is blocked by a local guard; ask the user to edit it manually." "$F"; exit 0;; package-lock.json|yarn.lock|pnpm-lock.yaml|bun.lockb|Gemfile.lock|composer.lock) jq -nc --arg en PreToolUse --arg d deny --arg r "Lockfiles must be regenerated via the package manager, not hand-edited." "$F"; exit 0;; esac; case "$b" in *.config.js|*.config.ts|*.config.mjs|*.config.cjs) jq -nc --arg en PreToolUse --arg d ask --arg r "Build/tooling config ($b); confirm before modifying." "$F"; exit 0;; esac; exit 0; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/prettier ] && ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/eslint ] && { out=$(./node_modules/.bin/eslint --fix "$f" 2>&1) || { echo "ESLint errors in $f:" >&2; echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; }; };; esac; exit 0; }

jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false' | { read -r a; [ "$a" = "true" ] && exit 0; [ -f package.json ] || exit 0; { git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACM HEAD 2>/dev/null; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard 2>/dev/null; } | grep -qiE '[.]tsx?$' || exit 0; if jq -e '.scripts.typecheck' package.json >/dev/null 2>&1; then out=$(npm run typecheck 2>&1) || { echo "TypeScript errors (npm run typecheck) - fix these before finishing:" >&2; echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; }; elif [ -f tsconfig.json ] && [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/tsc ]; then out=$(./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json 2>&1) || { echo "TypeScript errors (tsc --noEmit) - fix these before finishing:" >&2; echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; }; fi; exit 0; }
